bibliographic.title: Chloe Is Home
bibliographic.author: KhairikaSinani
bibliographic.description:
A flatmate group chat unknowingly welcomes an uninvited guest into their midst.
Part of the Interact-If's 2022 Game Jam.
PS- This is my first game jam ever, and I'd like to thank Brushmen for offering his support. He has been integral to the completion of this project, so I would like to show my appreciation for making my first game jam experience a memorable one! 
Please do check out his profile on itch.io, he's a wonderful writer and incredibly hard-working, so show your support for him and his work.

* Team Members:
Khairika & brushmen

* Program
Custom Macros from ChapelR, Cyrus Firheir

Engine: (Twine) SugarCube v.2.36.1
